title: Colour and Object Matching
goal: Build everyday vocabulary by linking words to visual icons.
steps: Look at the word shown on the screen.
Find the matching icon or color object.
Tap the correct item together with your child.
parent_tips: Say the word clearly and wait patiently for your child to respond.
Celebrate any effort, even if they need a second try.

content.prompt: Find the picture that matches the word:

strengths_message: Wonderful focus! You are great at connecting words and pictures.
